Name: Red-Crowned Crane Barn Animals for Content Patcher
Author: unamazement
Description:
This mod adds red-crowned cranes as [b]barn [/b]animals. They drop large eggs and red feathers [b]every 3 days[/b].[b]

You must install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and use SMAPI. [/b]Drag the folder inside the .zip into your Mods folder.

Crane eggs can be processed in a mayonnaise machine to produce [b]5[/b] [b]mayonnaise[/b]. The eggs cannot be incubated (they're barn animals). The feathers are just decorative, but they're valuable, and every NPC will like them as a gift.

The cranes take [b]5 [/b]days to grow up from unassuming-looking chicks. 

The lovely sprites for this mod were commissioned from[color=#00ffff] [url=https://pixelartjourney.itch.io/][color=#00ffff]PixelArtJourney/Scilex[/color][/url][/color] and used with minor alterations. If you use those assets, please link to this mod and also mention the artist's name in your description.

Downloads.Description: Fixed the cranes replacing red pandas from my other mod.
